subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v18: v17 + PER-BAND INSTANTANEOUS-FREQUENCY block. For each (t,b) compute in-band spectral centroid mu_b=sum(f P H_b)/sum(P H_b), bandwidth, log-geom-mean Hz, Q=mu/bw, deviation from band-center, ON/OFF FM, running var of cent_offset (FM mod depth) + multi-tau highpass + chirp ON/OFF. All NONLINEAR ratios of P(f) — unreachable by ridge over band powers. v17=0.0663.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v19: v18 + UNNORMALIZED BILINEAR BAND PRODUCTS c_a*c_b (NOT correlations). Near pairs (offset 1..4) at instant + EMA tau=15,60. Long-range pairs (8,12) at tau=30. LAG-ASYMMETRY pairs (offset 2,4 with lag 2,4): a(t)b(t-L) and a(t-L)b(t), plus signed asym difference. Captures lead/lag joint energy unreachable by ridge from band powers. Also dropped stmf_raw (v18 vs v17 was -0.0001, neutral). v18=0.0662.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v20: v18 + TSODYKS-MARKRAM SYNAPTIC DEPRESSION per band. Recurrent state R with R[t+1]=R[t]+(1-R[t])/tau_rec - u*drive*R; drive=c/EMA(c,30). 3 settings (tau_rec, u_rel) per band, rate + log(rate). Recurrent NONLINEAR adaptation produces onset transients + slow recovery matching auditory cortex high-gamma profile. Ridge cannot synthesize this from band powers. Replaces v19's bilinear block (neutral). v18=0.0662.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v21: v18 + NONLINEAR MATCHED-FILTER pattern detectors. 24 Gaussian templates over 8 centers x 3 widths in band space (zero-mean, unit norm). MF = log_c @ T - causal_bias(60). Outputs: ReLU(MF), ReLU(-MF), softmax(MF*1.5), and running-mean of each. Closed-form yet NONLINEAR — ReLU/softmax cannot be ridge-recovered from log_c. v18=0.0662, v19=0.0657 (bilinear), v20=0.0660 (TM adapt).

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v22: v21 + CASCADED L2 RANDOM-PROJECTION ReLU layer. After L1 (24 Gaussian-template ReLU/softmax detectors), apply fixed-seed random Gaussian projection K1=24->K2=40 + bias, ReLU. Two parallel L2 heads on mf_pos and mf_softmax + their EMA(30). True 2-stage NONLINEAR cascade — deeper than anything ridge can compose. v21=0.0668.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v23: v21 + NONLINEAR STMF POOLING. From stacked stmf_log (T,K,F): (1) per-filter soft-argmax band position + spread (where in spectrum filter k is firing), (2) per-filter soft band-max (ReLU half-wave), (3) softmax across filters (which spectro-temporal pattern dominates), (4) EMA(30) of both. Dropped v22 L2 random cascade (noisy). v21=0.0668, v22=0.0665.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v24: v23 + nonlinear POOLING applied to MODULATION ENVELOPES and LATERAL-INHIBITED cochleagram. Per mod-rate r: soft-argmax band, spread, soft band-max. Across rates: softmax (which rate dominates) + EMA(30). On lat: soft-argmax band (formant peak loc), spread, soft band-max, multi-tau highpass of peak position (formant glide speed). v23=0.0670.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v25: v24 + WITHIN-WINDOW envelope statistics per band from analytic signal. For each (t,b) build analytic z_b via rfft -> H_amp -> two-sided double -> ifft, take |z_b(n)| over the 4096-sample window: log_mean, CoV, skew, kurtosis. Discriminates voiced (peaky harmonic envelope) vs unvoiced (Gaussian noise) — info IMPOSSIBLE to recover from band power alone. + multi-tau highpass of CoV/skew/kurt for voicing onset/offset. v24=0.0670.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v26: v25 + extensions of within-window analytic stats: (a) ENVELOPE ASYMMETRY = CoV(first half) - CoV(second half) per band (onset vs decay envelope shape), (b) PER-BAND PITCH via envelope ACF: rfft env -> |Env|^2 -> irfft = autocorr; peak in lag range [SR/500, SR/75] gives per-band f0 + HNR (resolves 'missing fundamental' from unresolved harmonics in each band). v25=0.0682.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v27: v26 + per-band WITHIN-WINDOW envelope-modulation-spectrum sub-band powers. From Penv = |rfft(env)|^2 (already computed for pitch ACF), sum log-power over 5 bands: theta 4-12Hz (syllable), beta 12-32, gamma 32-100, F0 100-300, high-pitch 300-800. 5*24=120 NEW dim of envelope-rate content per band — orthogonal to pitch ACF peak (which is local periodicity). v26=0.0686.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v28: v27 + WITHIN-WINDOW CROSS-BAND envelope correlation at offsets (1,4,8). For each pair (a,b=a+off), rho = corr_n(env_a(n), env_b(n)) over the 4096-sample window. Voiced/harmonic signals have HIGHLY coherent pitch-rate envelope modulation across bands sharing F0 harmonics; noise is incoherent. Refactored env-stats method to single-pass (compute z/env once for all 24 bands). v27=0.0685, v26=0.0686.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v29: replaced v28 cross-band env corr (redundant) with TRUE CROSS-BAND PHASE-LOCK VALUE (PLV) at offsets (1,4,8). zn = z/|z| (unit phasor); cross_phasor = zn_a * conj(zn_b); PLV = |mean_n(cross_phasor)|, plus real and imag parts of the complex coherence (preferred phase). Voiced bands carrying same-F0 harmonics phase-lock (PLV~1); noise PLV~0. Captures CARRIER-frequency coherence, complementary to envelope ACF. v28=0.0684, v26=0.0686.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v30: v29 + VOICING-GATED channels. voiced_gate = sigmoid(per-band HNR - 3) ∈ [0,1]. Provide voiced_gate*log_c, (1-gate)*log_c, voiced_gate*CoV, unvoiced_gate*kurt — gives ridge SEPARATE voiced/unvoiced decoders for the same per-band features (an interaction term it cannot synthesize linearly). Plus a global cross-band gate. v29=0.0684.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v32: dropped v31 bilinear gates (OOM at 192GB). Added CEPSTRUM block (real cepstrum = irfft(log|F|^2)). Low quefrencies = vocal-tract envelope (MFCC-style c1..c24 + delta + delta-delta + EMA + multi-tau highpass). High quefrencies = excitation source: soft-argmax pitch period -> log F0, logsumexp peak val (voicing), CPP (peak − local mean), RMS, all with multi-tau highpass. CEPSTRUM is FUNDAMENTALLY nonlinear in band powers (log applied to spectrum) so adds orthogonal info. v30=0.0690.

subject: patient1
description: TEXTURE v33: trimmed STMF 22→13 filters to free dim. Kept v32 cepstrum + added COMPACT bilinear interactions. Scalar opponent-band PRODUCTS (low_pool×hi_pool, spec_tilt×voicing & complement, low/hi × voicing), per-band TRANSIENT gate (sigmoid(kurt-1)) × {log_c, unvoiced_gate}, per-band ONSET gate (sigmoid(d1*4)) × {voiced_gate, unvoiced_gate} = unvoiced bursts (fricatives/plosives) channel. v30=0.0690, v32=0.0691.
